title: Ravens OC Declan Doyle: OTAs are voluntary, but necessary to build winning teams

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens OC Declan Doyle: OTAs are voluntary, but necessary to build winning teams
sources.description: Ravens offensive coordinator Declan Doyle would like to see all of the team's veteran players on hand for the voluntary portion of the team's offseason program this year.
